entries.title: Job 26:2
segments: How have you helped [the] powerless, [or] saved [the] arm that has no strength?

entries.title: Job 26:3
segments: How have you advised [those] not wise, or fully declared wise plans?

entries.title: Job 26:4
segments: To whom have you spoken words? And whose spirit came from you?

entries.title: Job 26:5
segments: The departed spirits tremble under the waters, and those who dwell in them.

entries.title: Job 26:6
segments: Hell [is] naked before Him, and the Pit has no covering.

entries.title: Job 26:7
segments: He stretches out the north over the empty place, [and] He hung the earth on nothing.

entries.title: Job 26:8
segments: He binds up [the] waters in His thick clouds; and the cloud is not torn under them.

entries.title: Job 26:9
segments: He covers the face of [His] throne, spreading His cloud on it.

entries.title: Job 26:10
segments: He has described a circle on the surface of the waters to the boundary of light with darkness.

entries.title: Job 26:11
segments: The pillars of the heavens tremble and are astonished at His rebuke.

entries.title: Job 26:12
segments: He quiets the sea with His power, and by His understanding He shatters the proud.

entries.title: Job 26:13
segments: By His Spirit the heavens [were] beautiful; His hand pierced the fleeing serpent.

entries.title: Job 26:14
segments: Lo, these [are] the edges of His ways; but what a whisper of a word we hear of Him! And the thunder of His power who can understand?
